fields.name: CUST-ID
fields.description: Customer identifier — unsigned zoned decimal, mapped to LongType

fields.name: CUST-FIRST-NAME
fields.description: Customer first name — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CUST-MIDDLE-NAME
fields.description: Customer middle name — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CUST-LAST-NAME
fields.description: Customer last name — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CUST-ADDR-LINE-1
fields.description: Address line 1 — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CUST-ADDR-LINE-2
fields.description: Address line 2 — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CUST-ADDR-LINE-3
fields.description: Address line 3 (city) — alphanumeric, right-padded with spaces

fields.name: CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD
fields.description: State code — 2-character alphanumeric (e.g., NC, IN, GA)

fields.name: CUST-ADDR-ZIP
fields.description: ZIP/postal code — alphanumeric to support ZIP+4 format

fields.name: CUST-PHONE-NUM-1
fields.description: Primary phone number — alphanumeric (includes formatting chars)

fields.name: CUST-PHONE-NUM-2
fields.description: Secondary phone number — alphanumeric (includes formatting chars)

fields.name: CUST-SSN
fields.description: Social Security Number — zoned decimal but stored as StringType to preserve leading zeros

fields.name: CUST-DOB-YYYYMMDD
fields.description: Date of birth — alphanumeric date string (YYYY-MM-DD format)

fields.name: CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID
fields.description: EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) account identifier — alphanumeric

fields.name: CUST-PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND
fields.description: Primary cardholder indicator (Y/N) — single alphanumeric character

fields.name: CUST-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE
fields.description: FICO credit score — unsigned zoned decimal, mapped to IntegerType

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved filler bytes — unused padding to reach 500-byte record length
